GenAiPlugin.description: Check resource readiness, capacity pressure, queue risk, stock risk, equipment availability, and service counters.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Use Resource as the core primitive. A hospital room, hotel room, airport gate, bank case, supermarket batch, and cruise cabin are typed resources.
Calculate pressure, availability, stock cover, queue risk, SLA risk, missing evidence, and recommended resource actions.
Recommend restock, transfer, staffing, service counter, or resource release actions only as approval-gated proposals.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Use this topic when an issue mentions resource availability, queues, stock, capacity, service counters, rooms, gates, equipment, or staff load.
